submittedOn.description: The date the disclosures information was added. It must be provided in the format YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'

srn.description: Scheme Reference Number (SRN) of the tax avoidance scheme.

taxYear.description: The tax year in which the expected advantage arises, in the format `YYYY-YY`

supplementaryInformation.description: {{#unless (releasedInProduction 'r23_whitespace_docs')}}[Test only] {{/unless}}Additional information relating to counter-avoidance disclosures. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
supplementaryInformation.example: Additional information relating to a counter-avoidance disclosure and the circumstances being disclosed.

class2Nics.description: Object containing the Voluntary Class 2 National Insurance Contributions toggle.

class2VoluntaryContributions.description: Indicates whether Voluntary Class 2 contributions have been captured. The value must be true if this is the case.
